requirements.requirement: Preserve every pre-orb capability, stable ID, direct entry, companion path, extension path, migration, and undo behavior.
Pearl remains radically minimal, ethereal, companion-first, and progressively discloses only relevant controls.
Pearl data is encrypted, profile-isolated, offline-capable, local-first, and syncs only after scoped consent.
Logout, profile changes, account reloads, and organization switches clear decrypted/session state without cross-user access.
Page observation is bounded, excludes sensitive fields, and records approved disclosure without URL or log leakage.
Delete, lock, unlock, timeout, key rotation, recovery warning, migration, and corrupt-envelope handling are complete.
Web, Result, Studio, and recipient handoffs are short-lived, one-time, origin/profile/tab/scope bound, replay-safe, and fragment transported.
Every Pearl owns a page canvas with native pass-through, typed tools, coordinate correctness, local persistence, quota defense, and unsupported-page fallback.
Lens generation stages a persisted celadon Result Pearl with provenance and never silently mutates source material.
Every output asks destination, interprets a typed PlacementPlan, confirms, then executes once without regeneration.
Per-Pearl lawful local/provider soundscapes support rights gates, crossfade, offscreen continuity, offline, quota, and autoplay fallback.
Triple activation and accessible actions open the same Pearl in a secure editable full-tab Studio with CAS, checkpoints, undo, and conflict review.
Signed scoped Pearl packages preserve provenance, privacy review, ownership, expiry, revocation, updates, recipient onboarding, and atomic install.
Organization shares use tenant authorization, role checks, envelope encryption, restrictive inheritance, key rotation, and revocation.
Arbitrary pasted prompt systems compile into editable reusable automation Pearls while preserving verbatim evidence and semantic diff.
Current research is verified, bounded, injection-resistant, privacy guarded, review-patched, undoable, and refresh-budgeted.
Every Pearl instance uses one high-fidelity physical renderer without white-dot, emoji, generic-disc, glow, or fallback variants.
The physical Pearl transforms into one precise, non-draggable cursor with native input fallback and Triple-Space arbitration.
One versioned canonical Pearl entity and one action/event protocol govern all properties, surfaces, effects, receipts, checkpoints, policy, undo, and idempotency.
Every meaningful effect uses restrained effect-synchronized Pearl physics, cancellation, observation receipts, and reduced-motion static state.
Primitive, Role, Lens, Move, Function, and Pearl are explicit differentiated versioned editable cognitive layers.
AI organization preserves verbatim evidence, confidence, rationale, questions, conflicts, authorship, mappings, and blocks unresolved executable/shareable facts.
Studio separates spatial layout from semantic order and supports drag, reorder, nest, link, duplicate, split, merge, fork, remove, export, share, and cross-Pearl composition with bridge Moves.
Functions play, step, branch, pause, cancel, rerun, swap inputs/Lenses/Roles, and retain intermediate Result Pearls and exact checkpoints.
Companion observes and changes every authorized state through the complete capability graph while stating inaccessible, hidden, cross-origin, locked, or sensitive boundaries.
Natural language, stream-of-consciousness critique, deixis, interruption, background work, clarification, approval, partial failure, retry, research, and routing remain real and checkpointed.
First-use install through capture, Pearl creation, Lens result, routing, Studio edit, undo, and reload is deterministic and browser verified.
Large data, many Pearls, concurrent workers/tabs, switching, crash recovery, flapping network, quota, prompt injection, malicious packages, and stale observation are bounded and recoverable.
All Pearl states pass desktop, 360px, 200% zoom, touch, keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, high-contrast, light/dark, and text-heavy visual inspection.
